6.236 rsInvalidTablixCornerCellSpan
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidTablixCornerCellSpan is a critical error that will occur when a TablixCornerCell.CellContents,
CellContents.RowSpan, or CellContents.ColSpan element is set to "0" when CellContents actually
contains items or is set to nonzero when CellContents is empty.
